summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share buyback transactions under its pre-existing programme announced on 20 May 2025. From 13 to 17 July 2026, it purchased 180,791 ordinary shares at an average price of ~€26.38 per share and 82,426 ADS-represented shares at ~$32.25 per ADS, all for cancellation. No special-situation event—just routine open-market repurchases disclosed per EU MAR Article 5(1)(b). The filing is a standard periodic update with no strategic shift, tender offer, or activist involvement.
